name: How long does it take to repair door casing?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair door casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to repair door casing depends on the scope and severity of the damage. Simple cosmetic repairs, like patching and repainting a small section, might only take a few hours. More extensive repairs, such as replacing a significant portion of the casing due to water damage or installing an entirely new section, could take a full day or more, especially when factoring in drying times for fillers, primers, and paint. Multiple doors or complex trim styles will also extend the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor cosmetic fixes to a full day or more for extensive damage or section replacement, including drying times.
